fields.displayNameHint: How you want to appear in the list of people who helped. It can be your name, a nickname, or whatever you go by.
fields.anonymousHint: If this stays checked, whatever you bring still counts, but your name doesn't appear anywhere on the site.
fields.portraitHint: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 2 MB. It identifies you while you are signed in. It is not published on the site.
fields.portraitEmpty: There is no photo yet. The space stays reserved until you upload one.

signUp.title: Create an account
signUp.lead: It's for one thing only: offering to bring something from the list of what's missing, and having it written down under your name so two people don't bring the same thing. The email is so we can write to you, not to prove the donation is real.
signUp.seoDescription: Create an account on the site for rebuilding Norma's house, to offer to bring something from the list of what's missing.
signUp.privacyLead: We store your email and whatever you choose to show. It's all written out in
signUp.privacyTail: , and you can delete the account from the site whenever you want.
checkInboxBody: We sent a link to the address you typed. You have to open it: that is how we know that mailbox exists and that we can write to you. Until then the account is not active.
If it doesn't arrive within a few minutes, look in your spam folder.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.lead: With the account you created on this site.
signIn.seoDescription: Sign in to your account on the site for rebuilding Norma's house.

recover.title: Recover access
recover.lead: Type your email and we'll send you a link to set a new password.
recover.seoDescription: Recover access to your account on the site for rebuilding Norma's house.
sentBody: If that address has an account on this site, a link to set a new password just arrived in its inbox.
We say «if it has» on purpose: answering differently depending on whether the account exists would turn this form into a way of finding out who is registered here.

password.title: Set a new password
password.lead: This is the last step: the password you type here replaces the previous one.
password.seoDescription: Set a new password for your account on the site for rebuilding Norma's house.
password.noSessionTitle: This link doesn't work for this
noSessionBody: This screen opens from the link that arrives by email, and that link expires. The one you used has expired, or it was opened in a different browser.
Ask for a new one and try again.

profile.title: Your account
profile.lead: Everything the site stores about you is here, and this is where you change it or delete it.
profile.seoDescription: Your own account on the site for rebuilding Norma's house: how to appear, which language to write in, and how to delete it.
profile.appearanceLead: When you offer to bring something, you can appear in the list of people who helped, or not appear. You can change this at any time, and the change also applies to what you already offered.
profile.appearsAs: Right now you would appear as
profile.appearsAnonymous: Right now you would not appear: whatever you bring is counted without your name.
profile.portraitLead: It identifies you in the menu while you are signed in. It does not appear in Who helped or on any public page.
profile.passwordLead: The one you'll use from now on to sign in. Eight characters or more.
profile.deleteLead: Your email, your name, your phone, the pickup address and your preferences go, and it can't be undone. Anything you brought stays counted, without your name, because it's part of the public accounting of the work.
profile.unavailableBody: Accounts need the campaign's database, and this deployment doesn't have it configured yet. The rest of the site works.
profile.declinedTitle: The account wasn't approved this time
declinedBody: The team reviewed the request and did not approve the account this time. Nothing will be reserved under your name.
If this was a mistake, reply to the email we sent. You can delete the account from here.
profile.approvedNote: Your account is approved. From the catalogue you can note what you'll bring.
profile.pendingNote: You can already sign up to bring a good from the catalogue. Confirming the email was so we can write to you, not so you wait for an approval.
profile.pledgesHeading: What you signed up to bring
profile.pledgesLead: Each reservation expires after fourteen days. If you won't be able to bring it, cancel it so someone else can sign up.
profile.pledgesEmpty: You haven't signed up to bring anything yet. The list is in the catalogue.
profile.pledgeExpired: Expired on {when}. The units went back on the list.

errors.notConfigured: This part of the site isn't connected to the campaign's database yet. As soon as it is, accounts can be created.
errors.noSession: Your session expired. Sign in again.
errors.passwordShort: The password has to be eight characters or more.
errors.credentials: Those details don't match any account.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts in a row. Wait a while and try again.
errors.displayNameRequired: Type the name you want to appear under, or leave it checked that you'd rather not appear.
errors.contactNameRequired: Type a name so the team knows who they are talking to.
errors.pickupAddressRequired: Type the address where the good can be picked up.
errors.coverIsNotAPledge: Covering with money is not a reservation: transfer, and the team records it when it arrives.
errors.schemaBehind: The list was updated and this hold cannot be placed yet. You can try again in a little while.
errors.noRecoverySession: This link doesn't open a recovery session. Ask for a new one.
errors.linkExpired: That link has expired or has already been used. Ask for a new one.
errors.oauthFailed: Couldn't sign in with that network. Try again or use your email.
errors.oauthNoEmail: That network didn't give us an email, and without an email the account can't be created.
errors.internalRole: This account has a backoffice role. To delete it, the role has to be removed first.
errors.notApproved: This account is not approved. Nothing can be reserved under your name.
errors.ahead: Someone got there first: that unit is already reserved under someone else's name.
errors.tooManyPledges: You have five active reservations, which is the limit. Cancel one to note another.
errors.alreadyGone: That reservation is no longer active. Reload the account to see the current state.
errors.quantityInvalid: The quantity has to be a positive integer.
errors.failed: Couldn't complete that. The details are in the server log.
errors.portraitInvalid: That photo couldn't be used. JPEG, PNG and WebP up to 2 MB are accepted.
